scope: One wired 28-key keyboard with one 2u Space, one dial, one rounded magnetic riser, white per-key light and RGB base light. Complete cost is not yet established.

rows.label: Case, knob and ONE riser
rows.required: ₹4,498 with 4° provisionally; quote-only meshes, GST included. Heavy frost, navy finish, magnet capture parts, USB clamps and required manufacturing revisions are extra.

rows.label: Navy keycaps and white legends
rows.required: Quote the opaque navy shells AND translucent white legends, finishing, assembly and fit samples. Existing thin walls/inlay interference need revision; a shell print price would not cover the finished caps.

rows.label: Glossy black switch plate
rows.required: Separate fabrication, cutouts, tolerances and mirror-black finish. Do not charge the top again as part of the translucent lower case.

rows.label: Switches and 2u stabilizer
rows.required: Three ten-packs of BOX Jade: ₹840 incl GST, rechecked 18 Oct. Exact CHERRY G99-0742 stabilizer price/availability and any purchase pack size remain unquoted.

rows.label: Controller and remote USB-C
rows.required: ₹513.30 incl GST remains an out-of-stock listing, not a purchasable quote. Includes adapter and FPC cable: do not add those twice. Confirm stock and version or review an alternative.

rows.label: Custom carrier PCB and assembly
rows.required: Finish schematic, routed Gerbers/drill files, fabrication notes, assembly BOM and positions. Quote PCB batch, stencil, setup, component sourcing, SMT/THT soldering and test. Resolve 1.5 mm selected PCB versus Robu’s 1.6 mm option before quoting.

rows.label: White-key and RGB-base electronics
rows.quantity: 28 white LEDs + 1 driver + 1 buffer; 14 strip pixels installed, buy 1 m
rows.required: Source Kingbright APT1608QWF/D, IS31FL3236 driver, SN74AHCT1G125DBVR buffer and Adafruit 2969 strip. Quote strip purchase length, not just the fitted segment; confirm driver lifecycle/availability. Verify USB power budget and brightness limits.

rows.label: Matrix, encoder and support circuitry
rows.required: Exact Vishay diode and Bourns encoder quotes; driver current-setting resistor, I²C pull-ups, decoupling, strip bulk capacitor/data resistor, buffer bypass, wiring/connectors and test access. Review USB ESD/overcurrent protection and module-provided parts before adding quantities. The ₹224 Robu diode alternative is unapproved and excluded.

rows.label: Fasteners, magnets, feet and retention
rows.quantity: 4 magnets + 6 feet + 6 screws + 6 nuts; 4 closures + 2 USB clamps
rows.required: Two magnets in the case and two in the single bar; four case feet and two bar feet. Include capture closures, USB board clamps, compatible adhesive and assembly consumables; supplier packs may exceed installed counts.

rows.label: External USB data cable
rows.required: Kit FPC is internal and does not replace the host data cable. Check the actual plug fits the near-flush opening; do not budget a charge-only cable.

rows.label: Firmware, Windows helper and verification
rows.quantity: 1 working keyboard and helper; test samples
rows.required: Budget configuration/development, flashing, matrix/encoder/light tests and Windows volume synchronization. Add stem/stabilizer fit, diffuser/legend optical samples, USB insertion and riser retention tests, plus reprints/rework. Separate self-build time from paid assembly/tool costs.

rows.label: Delivered prototype spend
rows.quantity: Every supplier order, MOQ and one-off charge
rows.required: Track installed use versus packs/spares, batch minima, setup/tooling, finishing, assembly, samples, delivery, imports and taxes not already included. Include explicit rework allowance after quotes; no invented percentage or final total.

optional.label: Macro legend sheets and automatic profile identification
optional.required: Quote sheet tooling/material, opaque icon artwork, fitting and durability. NFC/RFID tags, reader/antenna, wiring and detection firmware remain undefined. Separate this add-on cost from the working base keyboard; it remains part of the feature roadmap.

optional.label: RGB per-key alternative
optional.required: The current model uses white per-key LEDs plus an RGB base. A per-key RGB comparison needs a separate LED/driver, PCB/power and firmware BOM, rather than assuming it costs the same.

optional.label: Second riser
optional.required: 7° replaces 4° in the current budget. Keep the second physical bar outside the base purchase; alternative three-body print subtotal ₹5,346.

closingRule: A full total requires approved manufacturing geometry, a complete electrical BOM, stock-confirmed supplier quotes with quantities/MOQs, finishing and assembly, sample/rework allowances and destination-specific delivery/taxes. Unknown costs stay unquoted, never zero.
